overview_description.description: Alchemy Global builds, owns and operates clean energy and infrastructure projects under the Alchemy Global brand. The organization focuses on renewable natural gas, liquid biofuels, SME solar, bottle-to-bottle plastics recycling and carbon offset projects. It collaborates with project developers, EPC companies and investors to deploy clean infrastructure at scale. The firm applies an asset-level financing model to support emerging clean infrastructure segments while limiting dilution for project promoters. It targets projects that conventional financing often overlooks and aims to support the development of a circular, low-carbon economy.
